children: California diesel prices have surged to record levels, with the statewide average gasoline price topping $8 per gallon and one San Diego gas station posting $9.99. According to Sina Finance, the shortage of fuel supply, lower refining capacity, limited pipeline capacity, and the state's high taxes and fees have intensified the crisis, while global conflicts have added pressure to energy markets.

The rise in diesel prices has hit industries that rely heavily on the fuel, including trucking, moving, and construction companies. As fuel costs jump, many businesses have been forced to raise prices or accept lower profit margins, pushing up inflation and increasing the cost of goods and services for consumers.

title: US Market Close | California Diesel Prices Hit Record Highs as Fuel Costs Surge
